attchmntText: Bhartiya International Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Bhartiya International Limited submitted its earnings presentation for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 to the National Stock Exchange. For Q2 FY2027, consolidated revenue was Rs. 507 crore, up 26.9% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 51 crore, up 26.6%, with an EBITDA margin of 10.0%. Profit before tax was Rs. 34 crore, up 65.3%, and profit after tax was Rs. 25 crore, up 72.8%. For H1 FY2027, revenue reached Rs. 880 crore, up 29.5% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs. 42 crore, up 94.7%. Net worth as of 30th September 2026 was Rs. 529 crore. The company reported a net working capital of 185 days and a return on capital employed of 12.7%.

attchmntText: Bhartiya International Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Outcome of the Board Meeting   Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half-Year Ended September 30, 2026, and Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flow Statement for the Half-Year Ended September 30, 2026.'.
voiceSummary: Bhartiya International Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 12th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company submitted Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results along with a Limited Review Report to the National Stock Exchange of India and BSE Limited. The financial results indicate revenue of Rs. 506.9 crore for the second quarter of FY27, compared to Rs. 399.4 crore in the corresponding period of FY26. Profit After Tax for the quarter was Rs. 25.2 crore, up from Rs. 14.6 crore in the previous year. Half-year revenue stood at Rs. 879.7 crore against Rs. 679.4 crore in the prior year. The results are subject to publication in newspapers as per Listing Regulations.

attchmntText: Bhartiya International Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bhartiya International Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved these results on 12th November 2026. Revenue from operations was 42091.80 lacs for the quarter and 72692.13 lacs for the half year. Profit before tax stood at 3306.12 lacs for the quarter and 5352.96 lacs for the half year. Profit for the period was 2375.18 lacs for the quarter and 3907.83 lacs for the half year. Basic earnings per share were 17.71 for the quarter and 29.14 for the half year. Total assets increased to 139687.26 lacs from 123361.48 lacs at the end of the previous financial year. The Limited Review Report by A S Poddar & Associates confirmed no material misstatements.
